header.schema_hash_formula: md5(concat(names)) + sha256(json).hex[:16] mirror of src/features/feature_schema.py:237/243-248 (v6.0 generated vector)

rows.name: open
rows.formula_or_source: identity — raw bar-open price as ingested from the broker/data feed; no transform

rows.name: high
rows.formula_or_source: identity — raw bar-high price as ingested from the broker/data feed; no transform

rows.name: low
rows.formula_or_source: identity — raw bar-low price as ingested from the broker/data feed; no transform

rows.name: close
rows.formula_or_source: identity — raw bar-close price as ingested from the broker/data feed; no transform

rows.name: volume
rows.formula_or_source: identity — raw bar volume as ingested from the broker/data feed; no transform

rows.name: body_size
rows.formula_or_source: abs(close - open)

rows.name: candle_range
rows.formula_or_source: high - low

rows.name: upper_wick
rows.formula_or_source: high - max(open, close)

rows.name: lower_wick
rows.formula_or_source: min(open, close) - low

rows.name: total_wick
rows.formula_or_source: upper_wick + lower_wick

rows.name: body_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: body_size/candle_range

rows.name: body_to_total_wick_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: candle_math.body_to_total_wick_ratio

rows.name: upper_wick_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: upper_wick/candle_range

rows.name: lower_wick_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: lower_wick/candle_range

rows.name: disp_strength
rows.formula_or_source: clip(body_size / (atr * close), <feature_pipeline.disp_strength_clip_low>, <feature_pipeline.disp_strength_clip_high>) if atr>0 and close>0 else nan  # defaults 0.0, 3.0

rows.name: retest_depth
rows.formula_or_source: clip(abs(close - ema_fast) / (atr * close), <feature_pipeline.retest_depth_clip_low>, <feature_pipeline.retest_depth_clip_high>) if retest_flag==1 and atr>0 and close>0 else 0.0  # defaults 0.0, 1.0

rows.name: ema_spread
rows.formula_or_source: (ema_fast - ema_slow) / atr if atr>0 else nan   # emitted only when <feature_pipeline.normalization_basis> == 'atr_relative' (the default); 'atr_absolute' selects FM-030 instead

rows.name: momentum_score
rows.formula_or_source: close_delta / atr if atr>0 else nan   # close_delta = close.diff(); emitted only when <feature_pipeline.normalization_basis> == 'atr_relative' (the default); 'atr_absolute' selects FM-031 instead

rows.name: ema_spread_atr
rows.formula_or_source: (ema_fast - ema_slow) / (atr * close) if atr>0 and close>0 else nan   # emitted only when <feature_pipeline.normalization_basis> == 'atr_absolute'; the default 'atr_relative' selects FM-022 instead

rows.name: momentum_score_atr
rows.formula_or_source: close_delta / (atr * close) if atr>0 and close>0 else nan   # close_delta = close.diff(); emitted only when <feature_pipeline.normalization_basis> == 'atr_absolute'; the default 'atr_relative' selects FM-023 instead

rows.name: volatility_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: (high - low) / (atr * close) if atr>0 and close>0 else 1.0

rows.name: liquidity_distance
rows.formula_or_source: min over levels of abs(close - level) / (atr * close), clipped >= 0; nan if atr*close<=0 or no finite level

rows.name: liquidity_pressure_score
rows.formula_or_source: clip(exp(<feature_pipeline.liquidity_decay_coeff> * liquidity_distance), 0.0, 1.0); nan distance -> treated as <feature_pipeline.liquidity_nan_sentinel>  # defaults -0.5, 10.0

rows.name: displacement_retrace
rows.formula_or_source: clip(|retest_close - disp_open| / |disp_close - disp_open|, 0.0, 1.0); disp body 0 -> skip

rows.name: displacement_atr_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: candle_range / atr_abs; atr_abs<=0 -> 0.0  # atr_abs = SMA(period) of true_range, ABSOLUTE price units (state.atr_abs, now registered as FM-074 atr_absolute), NOT the close-relative FM-041 `atr`

rows.name: disp_strength_atr_rescale
rows.formula_or_source: disp_strength / atr; atr<=0 -> 0.0

rows.name: candles_since_retest_state
rows.formula_or_source: current_candle_index - retest_candle_index

rows.name: order_block_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh(sign * (close - order_block_zone_edge) / atr); 0.0 if no active OB or atr<=0

rows.name: fvg_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh(sign * (close - fvg_zone_edge) / atr); 0.0 if no active FVG or atr<=0

rows.name: breaker_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh(sign * (close - breaker_zone_edge) / atr); 0.0 if no active breaker or atr<=0

rows.name: mitigation_block_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh(sign * (close - mitigation_zone_edge) / atr); 0.0 if no live mitigation block or atr<=0

rows.name: pdh_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh(-(close - prev_day_high) / atr); 0.0 if no closed D1 parent yet or atr<=0

rows.name: pdl_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh((close - prev_day_low) / atr); 0.0 if no closed D1 parent yet or atr<=0

rows.name: eqh_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh(-(close - eqh_level) / atr); 0.0 if no equal-highs cluster found or atr<=0

rows.name: eql_distance
rows.formula_or_source: tanh((close - eql_level) / atr); 0.0 if no equal-lows cluster found or atr<=0

rows.name: true_range
rows.formula_or_source: max(high - low, abs(high - prev_close), abs(low - prev_close))

rows.name: atr
rows.formula_or_source: SMA(<feature_pipeline.atr_period>) of true_range, close-relative: atr_14_raw / close (atr_14_raw = true_range.rolling(<feature_pipeline.atr_period>).mean())  # default 14

rows.name: atr_absolute
rows.formula_or_source: SMA(<feature_pipeline.atr_period>) of true_range, ABSOLUTE price units (no division by close): true_range.rolling(<feature_pipeline.atr_period>).mean()  # default 14

rows.name: rsi_14
rows.formula_or_source: 100 - 100/(1+RS); RS = SMA(<feature_pipeline.rsi_period>) gain / (SMA(<feature_pipeline.rsi_period>) loss + 1e-9); clipped [0,100]  # default period 14

rows.name: ema_fast
rows.formula_or_source: close.ewm(span=<feature_pipeline.ema_fast_span>, adjust=False).mean()  # default 9

rows.name: ema_slow
rows.formula_or_source: close.ewm(span=<feature_pipeline.ema_slow_span>, adjust=False).mean()  # default 21

rows.name: swing_high
rows.formula_or_source: causal DELAYED publication of a centered rolling-max swing high over width 2k+1 (FC1-A: math at t, published with k-bar delay, available_at = t+k); k = <feature_pipeline.swing_window>  # default 2

rows.name: swing_low
rows.formula_or_source: causal DELAYED publication of a centered rolling-min swing low over width 2k+1 (FC1-A); k = <feature_pipeline.swing_window>  # default 2

rows.name: macd_line
rows.formula_or_source: close.ewm(span=<feature_pipeline.macd_fast>, adjust=False).mean() - close.ewm(span=<feature_pipeline.macd_slow>, adjust=False).mean()  # defaults 12, 26

rows.name: macd_signal
rows.formula_or_source: macd_line.ewm(span=<feature_pipeline.macd_signal>, adjust=False).mean()  # default 9

rows.name: macd_hist_raw
rows.formula_or_source: macd_line - macd_signal

rows.name: macd_hist_z
rows.formula_or_source: rolling(<feature_pipeline.zscore_window>) z-score of macd_hist_raw  # default 50

rows.name: trend_strength_z
rows.formula_or_source: rolling(<feature_pipeline.zscore_window>) z-score of SMA(<feature_pipeline.trend_strength_window>) of diff(SMA(<feature_pipeline.ma_periods[0]>) of close)  # defaults 50, 10, 20

rows.name: trend_strength_raw
rows.formula_or_source: SMA(<feature_pipeline.trend_strength_window>) of diff(SMA(<feature_pipeline.ma_periods[0]>) of close)  # defaults 10, 20

rows.name: volatility_regime
rows.formula_or_source: tercile(atr_14.rolling(<feature_pipeline.volatility_percentile_window>, min_periods=1).rank(pct=True)); atr_14 = SMA(14) of true_range (ABSOLUTE); cuts at <feature_pipeline.volatility_tercile_low>/<feature_pipeline.volatility_tercile_high> -> int8 {0,1,2}  # defaults 200, 0.33/0.66

rows.name: volume_ratio
rows.formula_or_source: volume / SMA(volume, <feature_pipeline.volume_ma_window>); 1.0 where the moving average is <= 0  # default 20

rows.name: volume_spike
rows.formula_or_source: volume_ratio > rolling(<feature_pipeline.volume_spike_adaptive_window>, min_periods=<feature_pipeline.volume_spike_min_samples>).quantile(<feature_pipeline.volume_spike_percentile>/100); where that threshold is NaN fall back to <feature_pipeline.volume_spike_fixed_fallback> -> int8 {0, 1}  # defaults 50, 20, 75, 1.5

rows.name: candles_since_sweep
rows.formula_or_source: cumcount of bars since the last liquidity_sweep event (groupby (liquidity_sweep != 0).cumsum()); 0 before the first sweep. Falls back to a retest_flag-keyed grouping ONLY when liquidity_sweep is absent from the frame (feature_pipeline.py:988-991) — non-authoritative, unreachable in production per the certification ledger.

rows.name: last_swing_high_price
rows.formula_or_source: forward-fill of high where the centered swing-high pivot fired, then shifted by k = <feature_pipeline.swing_window> (FC1-A causal publication)  # default 2

rows.name: last_swing_low_price
rows.formula_or_source: forward-fill of low where the centered swing-low pivot fired, then shifted by k = <feature_pipeline.swing_window> (FC1-A causal publication)  # default 2

rows.name: hour_of_day
rows.formula_or_source: timestamp.dt.hour -> int8

rows.name: session
rows.formula_or_source: window model over <feature_pipeline.session_windows_utc>, half-open [start, end): OVERLAP if in LONDON and NEWYORK; else NEWYORK; else LONDON; else ASIA; else CLOSED -> int8  # defaults ASIA [0,9) LONDON [7,16) NEWYORK [12,21)

rows.name: trend_bias
rows.formula_or_source: sign(ema_fast - ema_slow) -> float32 {-1, 0, +1}

rows.name: higher_high
rows.formula_or_source: high > prev(last_swing_high_price) -> int8 {0, 1}; NaN reference compares False

rows.name: lower_low
rows.formula_or_source: low < prev(last_swing_low_price) -> int8 {0, 1}; NaN reference compares False

rows.name: break_of_structure
rows.formula_or_source: +1 if close > prev(last_swing_high_price); -1 if close < prev(last_swing_low_price); else 0 -> int8

rows.name: liquidity_sweep
rows.formula_or_source: +1 if high > ref_high and close <= ref_high; -1 if low < ref_low and close >= ref_low; else 0 -> int8   # ref_* = prev(last_swing_*_price)

rows.name: sweep_detected
rows.formula_or_source: liquidity_sweep != 0 -> int8 {0, 1}

rows.name: double_sweep
rows.formula_or_source: any(liquidity_sweep > 0) and any(liquidity_sweep < 0) over rolling(<feature_pipeline.double_sweep_window>, min_periods=1) -> int8 {0, 1}  # default 5

rows.name: retest_flag
rows.formula_or_source: rolling_any(liquidity_sweep != 0, <feature_pipeline.retest_lookback>) and abs(close - ema_fast) <= <feature_pipeline.retest_atr_band_mult> * atr * close -> int8 {0, 1}  # defaults 10, 1.0

rows.name: rsi_state
rows.formula_or_source: +1 if rsi_14 > <feature_pipeline.rsi_overbought>; -1 if rsi_14 < <feature_pipeline.rsi_oversold>; else 0 -> int8  # defaults 70, 30

rows.name: displacement_flag
rows.formula_or_source: body_size > candle_range * <feature_pipeline.displacement_strong_body_mult> and atr > 0 -> int8 {0, 1}  # default 0.6

rows.name: body_commitment
rows.formula_or_source: bin(body_ratio; band_edges) -> int8 {0,1,2}  # identity transform; edges ontology-owned

rows.name: atr_magnitude
rows.formula_or_source: bin(percentile_rank(atr | series); band_edges) -> int8 {0,1,2}  # series percentile of FM-041 relative atr

rows.name: momentum_magnitude
rows.formula_or_source: bin(percentile_rank(|momentum_score| | series); band_edges) -> int8 {0,1,2}  # F-061: never fixed abs edges on legacy FM-023

rows.name: change_of_character
rows.formula_or_source: break_of_structure if sign(break_of_structure) != sign(trend_bias) and both nonzero, else 0

feature_enum.note: Feature-value -> meaning map declared in ontology states blocks (name/value/condition/description shape).

rows.activation_condition: high <= previous last_swing_high_price, or no reference exists yet
low >= previous last_swing_low_price, or no reference exists yet
close within the prior structural range
at most one sweep direction present in the trailing window
both a positive and a negative liquidity_sweep within the trailing window
no sweep within retest_lookback bars, or |close - ema_fast| outside the ATR band
sweep within retest_lookback bars AND |close - ema_fast| <= retest_atr_band_mult * atr * close
break_of_structure == 0 or trend_bias == 0 or sign(break_of_structure) == sign(trend_bias)

smc_choch.note: SMC structural signal (CHoCH) — a signed combination, NOT a state machine.

rows.activation_condition: break_of_structure != 0 and trend_bias != 0 and sign(break_of_structure) != sign(trend_bias)
rows.note: Pure signed operation over registered features (BOS x trend_bias); the ontology explicitly excludes BOS/CHOCH detection state-machines (market_ontology.yaml:32).

Feature identities referenced by Shape predicates

S5_traceable_ontology.note: Code relationships, not prose: a feature is bound to a vector slot (S1); feature-enum states are declared in ontology states blocks (S2b); CRT/Shape predicates reference those state names (verified above); the planner consumes the features (required-keys).

S7_orphans.note: Orphans are reported, never silently normalised. A shape.when key that is not a declared feature-enum state is a linkage gap to surface.
